description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Miss Fortune''' fires a shot at the target enemy that deals physical damage and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] effects to the primary target and [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects to both enemies hit.
description.text: Active: Miss Fortune fires a shot at the target enemy that deals physical damage and bounces to hit another enemy behind them, applying on-attack effects to the primary target and on-hit effects to both enemies hit.

description2.raw: ''Double Up's'' bounce can [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]] for「 (150% + [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|15%]]) damage. 」「 [[File:Critical strike damage icon.png|15px|link=Critical strike]] 50% '''bonus''' critical damage. 」If ''Double Up'' kills the primary target, the bounce will [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically strike]].
description2.text: Double Up's bounce can critically strike for「 (150% +  15%) damage. 」「  50% bonus critical damage. 」If Double Up kills the primary target, the bounce will critically strike.

description3.raw: ''The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] to be hit by the bounce.''
description3.text: The bounce prioritizes units directly behind the primary target. A target does not have to be visible to be hit by the bounce.

If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing. * Neutral units count as valid targets to bounce. * The bounce follows a priority order on targets behind in a certain angle: *# 500 units in 20º. *# 500 units in 40º. *# 500 units in 110º. *# 150 units in 160º. * ''Double Up's'' cast range adjusts based on '''Miss Fortune's''' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] attack range, which can be increased by items such as [[File:Rapid Firecannon item.png|20xpx|border|link=Rapid Firecannon|An icon for the item Rapid Firecannon]] [[Rapid Firecannon]]. * The damage of a [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critically striking]] shot is 30 / 67.5 / 105 / 142.5 / 180 (+ 150% AD) (+ 52.5% AP) physical damage, increased to 33 / 74.25 / 115.5 / 156.75 / 198 (+ 165% AD) (+ 57.75% AP) physical damage by [[File:Infinity Edge item.png|20xpx|border|link=Infinity Edge|An icon for the item Infinity Edge]] [[Infinity Edge|Infinity Edge's]] bonus critical damage. * If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground. ** The dud lands on the ground 176 units behind the primary target and has a missile speed of 400 on its way there. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Double Up deals basic damage to both targets, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage.
Spell shields can be used by either target. If it is on the primary target, the spell shield will not prevent the shot from bouncing.
Neutral units count as valid targets to bounce.
The bounce follows a priority order on targets behind in a certain angle:
# 500 units in 20º.
# 500 units in 40º.
# 500 units in 110º.
# 150 units in 160º.
Double Up's cast range adjusts based on Miss Fortune's  attack range, which can be increased by items such as Rapid Firecannon.
The damage of a critically striking shot is 30 / 67.5 / 105 / 142.5 / 180 (+ 150% AD) (+ 52.5% AP) physical damage, increased to 33 / 74.25 / 115.5 / 156.75 / 198 (+ 165% AD) (+ 57.75% AP) physical damage by Infinity Edge's bonus critical damage.
If there is no secondary target, the shot will not bounce and the dud will instead fall to the ground.
* The dud lands on the ground 176 units behind the primary target and has a missile speed of 400 on its way there.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
